_README: Curated, client-facing reason/disposition overrides for the Encore deliverable workbook. COMMITTED (durable) home for blocked/skipped/manual reasons that have no other committed source — replaces the gitignored, GC-prone fixme-registry.json baseline-restoration entries (LR-ENC-004, 2026-06-05). Applied by export_test_cases/to-xlsx.ts AFTER augment+overlay, BEFORE the Pass+reason integrity throw. Per entry: 'coverage' (optional, e.g. 'Manual'), 'execution' (''|'Skipped'|'Blocked'), 'reason' (client-safe professional text — NO slang, framework, BUG-IDs, or contradictions; passes scripts/xlsx-lint-rules.mjs). Do NOT add a reason to a Passing test (would trip C1).

_README_LI_TERSE_SUPPRESSED: Temporary blank overrides (2026-06-09, user-directed). These 8 Local Information rows carry only a terse internal-shorthand reason in reports/fixme-registry.json (a `// FIXME TC-NNN (label)` comment in the spec, e.g. 'JobCosting', 'eSignature', 'Oracle required'). They are not-yet-automated/planned rows (Coverage = Pending Automation) and the lint's TERSE_REASON_ALLOWLIST exempts them from the client-sentence check. Until the spec-restructure fix (chip task_a8298e85) those labels never reached the workbook; the fix would now surface them in the client-facing 'Notes / Reason' column. Per user direction they ship BLANK (as they do today) rather than leak internal shorthand to the client — proper client-facing reasons are to be authored later. Setting reason='' (and execution='') here makes blocked-reasons.json, the build's last writer, blank the cell after the overlay applies the terse registry label.
